description: This file contains the main activity and associated fragments for demonstrating flexible layouts using Android fragments, including list and detail fragments with dual-pane support for tablets and single-pane for phones.

classes.name: FragmentLayout
classes.description: Main activity class that manages the layout and interacts with fragments; supports different configurations for layouts.

classes.name: FragmentLayout.DetailsActivity
classes.description: Secondary activity that shows details when not in dual-pane layout.

classes.name: FragmentLayout.TitlesFragment
classes.description: ListFragment displaying titles; manages item selection and fragment replacement for details.

classes.name: FragmentLayout.DetailsFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying detailed text for an item, supports dynamic content based on selected index.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the main activity and sets the content view.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the DetailsActivity, checks orientation, and adds details fragment if needed.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the titles list, determines dual-pane mode, restores state, and configures list selection.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the currently selected item index.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks and triggers showing details either inline or via new activity.

methods.name: showDetails
methods.description: Displays the details for a selected item; replaces fragment in dual-pane mode or starts new activity.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DetailsFragment with the specified index.

methods.name: getShownIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the item currently shown in DetailsFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the view hierarchy for DetailsFragment, showing dialogue text for the given index.
